title: AWS <> GitHub connection
content:
GitHub PAT

To access GitHub from AWS CodeBuild use a Personal Access Token (PAT). To create a PAT follow this guide: https://help.github.com/en/github/authenticating-to-github/creating-a-personal-access-token-for-the-command-line

The idea is to have a “IPEX Build Bot” user in GitHub for whom the PAT will be created. This is however not in place yet. So for now the PAT must belong to a human.

CodeBuild setup

To setup the connection between AWS CodeBuild and GitHub using PAT follow this guide: https://help.github.com/en/github/authenticating-to-github/creating-a-personal-access-token-for-the-command-line

Access your source provider in CodeBuild - AWS CodeBuild (amazon.com)

To have AWS CodeBuild trigger on different events in GitHub follow this guide for setup: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/sample-github-pull-request.html
